note: every programme outcome is one of the issue's section-21 terminals; PARENT_SUFFICIENT variants are first-class SUCCESS, not failures

DEVELOPMENT_CHANGE_ADOPTED.meaning: a morphology passed the full M11 path (probe dominance, shadow suites, assurance, external proxy decision) and installed generation g+1

EXTERNAL_ADOPTION_REJECTED.meaning: assurance passed but the frozen external authority (model proxy) declined; generation unchanged

SELF_EVOLUTION_REGRESSES.meaning: M11 assurance failed on the shadow suites; nothing installed

SELF_DIAGNOSIS_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE.meaning: the forwarded candidate did not dominate the incumbent on independent re-measurement inside the cell

PARENT_SUFFICIENT_NO_ADOPTION.meaning: waves exhausted with no admissible dominant candidate: the incumbent g2 morphology is sufficient on the fresh contract distribution; SUCCESS terminal
issuers: centre_aggregate.py finalize after the frozen wave bound

PARENT_SUFFICIENT_BY_REVIVAL_EXHAUSTION.meaning: negative waves attributed to one stage each, the matching revival lever applied in the next wave, and still no dominant candidate; SUCCESS terminal
issuers: centre_aggregate.py finalize after the frozen wave bound

CANNOT_CHECK.meaning: a measurement could not be completed (incomplete relevance/revision resources, crashed task); recorded, never silently dropped

generation_bound.honest_ceiling: g2 entering; g3+ only per DEVELOPMENT_CHANGE_ADOPTED cycle

adverse_rows: H9 always records its adverse example; ADVERSE_RECORDED is a measurement outcome, not a failure
